verifications.claim: The 2026 Men’s March Madness tournament games air on CBS, TBS, TNT, and truTV.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The NCAA Tournament games will be shown on CBS, TBS, TNT and truTV." (R1); "TV channel: CBS, TNT, TBS, truTV." (R2); "Live game coverage will air on available CBS affiliates and nationally on TNT, TBS, and TruTV." (R3); "Enjoy games on TBS, TNT, truTV, and CBS!" (R4); "TV channels: CBS, TBS, TNT, TruTV" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state the men's tournament airs on these exact four channels.

verifications.claim: The Final Four and championship game of the 2026 Men’s March Madness tournament air on TBS.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The Final Four and national championship will also air on TBS" (R1)
verifications.reasoning: R1 directly confirms the Final Four and championship air on TBS.

verifications.claim: Women's March Madness games are available on ESPN, ESPN2, ESPNU, ESPNews, and ABC.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Live coverage of the women’s games will air on available ABC affiliates and nationally on ESPN, ESPN2, ESPNU, and ESPNews." (R3); "The women’s NCAA tournament will air across the ESPN suite — ESPN, ESPN2, ESPNU, ESPNews and ABC." (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly list these exact channels for women's games.

verifications.claim: March Madness Live App is the official app to watch all 2026 Men’s March Madness tournament games.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "March Madness Live app" as streaming option for all games (R1); "Official App of the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Tournament... watch all 67 games" (R4); "With NCAA March Madness Live, you can watch every game" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Sources describe it as the official app for streaming all men's tournament games.

verifications.claim: March Madness Live app requires a TV provider login for extended viewing.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "sign into the March Madness Live app with their TV login credentials" (R1)
verifications.reasoning: R1 directly states TV login is required to watch games on the app.

verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm Paramount+ (Premium) streams all CBS March Madness games.
